scope: Retrospective newest A-E matched empty-human-empty records. All earlier results retained. No surveyed human coordinates in prediction code. No new captures, thesis edits or uploads.
questions: Can shared antennas support a complex 12-element virtual snapshot over one switch cycle?
Can a frozen R1 broadside-dominant empirical phase reference transfer to held empty data?
Does 12-element MUSIC improve all-site estimates over equal-packet G2, including failures?
budget: 24 complete six-state cycles per run, evenly spread in time, 6 deterministic time-spread packets per visit, hence 864 distinct packets per run. If any visit has fewer than 6 packets it is ineligible; preserve count. G2 control uses 864 distinct packets spread across the same 10 s, grouped into 24 consecutive batches of 36 packets. R1 first 8 selected cycles/batches form development reference (288 total packets per arm), remaining 16 are held out. R2 first 12 predict; last 12 validate. R3 is entirely held out. At least 24 eligible cycles and 864 G2 packets required; otherwise stop site without replacement.
clock: Existing verified decoder, antenna permutation, target MAC, READY alignment and [3,21) ms interior. Preserve actual cycle, packet and timestamp identifiers. No interpolated packets or simultaneous-observation claim.
packet_alignment: Per visit first selected packet is local reference; Ratnam-inspired conditional ML fits one common phase and baseband-frequency slope to all 3 chains. No independent chain corrections. Cross-fit first two chains and 20/30 tones, evaluate untouched entries. All-packet common model and 90% coverage checked, not just minimized training loss.
stitching: Primary spanning tree rooted at C1, G1 via shared antenna1, G2 via6, G3 via8, C2 via6, G4 via10. Each edge fits phase+slope and positive scalar amplitude on 20 tones; held10 tones test prediction. C1-C2 shared antenna8 is an unused spatial closure test. Secondary tree swaps C1-C2 shared6 with shared8 and reserves6. Tree compositions preserve common frequency phase. Repeat on first/last three packets in each visit to test time sensitivity. No covariance completion, zero-filling missing pairs or invented simultaneous snapshots.
gauge: Shared antenna always uses the same receiver chain. Shared constraints cannot identify fixed chain/cable/antenna response independently of the unknown channel. Empirical R1 phase-to-known-TX correction is explicitly a direct-path-dominance hypothesis, not verified hardware calibration. Known TX phase uses exact element distances at 3.65m; human geometry is not used.
music: Calculate actual 12x12 per-frequency covariances from the conditionally stitched complex vectors, retaining cross-G blocks. Compare raw-phase and R1 empirical phase-reference hypotheses. Full 12-element background-projected MUSIC q=1 is primary; q=2 and 8-element forward-backward spatial smoothing are labelled sensitivities. G2 uses the same background projection, geometry and total packet budget. Transform data with the assumed inverse hardware response, and use a physical steering vector only under that explicit calibration hypothesis. Pure numerical preconditioning would also transform steering and is not calibration.
release: Report numerical diagnostics independently of physical release. Shared-model acceptance, held reference stability, temporal/frequency peak consistency, alternative-tree consistency, foreground-over-empty contrast and no stable empty counterpart are necessary. Independent fixed-response/LoS validation is additionally necessary for physically validated human AoA. No such dataset has been supplied; do not silently mark that gate passed.
refinement: Separate bounded local-refinement study reuses earlier equal-budget packet roles. Fit proposed reliability weights using R2 Q1/Q2 only, validate Q3/Q4, half bands and R3. G2 first candidate determines a fixed +/-9deg search; +/-18deg only declared sensitivity. All arms use same rule. No pointwise backend selection. Any weighted fallback that equals G2 is recorded as zero array gain.
metrics: Predictions, spectra, source hashes and gates are saved before a separate scorer joins survey truth. Report each point, all-site provisional MAE, accepted count, conditional error, boundaries, rank sensitivities and incorrect outputs. Existing data are development evidence, not unseen independent testing. Any demonstrated computational/aperture benefit is distinct from measured human accuracy.
